senses.example: No encuentro las gafas por ninguna parte.
senses.exampleGloss: I cannot find my glasses anywhere.

alternatives.reason: Peninsular word for contacts; often confused with gafas de sol or gafas.
LatAm form; not Peninsular for everyday glasses.

notes: Plural-only noun; gafas de sol and gafas de cerca are the two everyday collocations.
